principle: Scientific claims are data, not UI text.

modules.scope: Degree-preserving null-model testing for network structure.
modules.what_this_means: The tool compares an observed network statistic against a degree-preserving null distribution.
limitations: A result outside the null interval does not establish causality.
It does not establish a physical law or mechanism.
Small networks or insufficient null samples may produce unstable results.
Important findings require independent replication and domain review.

modules.scope: Controlled computational validation under registered non-Gaussian telemetry conditions.
modules.what_this_means: Benchmark 002 completed its registered reproducibility closure with a PASS under the tested computational conditions.
limitations: This is controlled computational evidence, not physical-system certification.
The result applies only to the tested benchmark conditions.
It does not establish universal detector performance.
Independent physical validation would be required for real-world safety claims.

modules.scope: Controlled computational stress testing across Gaussian, Laplace, Student-t df3 and Uniform noise families.
modules.what_this_means: Benchmark 003 failed its registered primary stress criteria. The failure is preserved as evidence rather than hidden or retuned.
limitations: The protocol coverage was partial: multiple signal dynamics were not executed.
The independent seed-batch replication criterion was not evaluated.
No universal normalized failure boundary was established.
This benchmark provides computational evidence only.

modules.scope: First frozen held-out evaluation on seeds 4201-4210, with no post-result detector retuning.
modules.what_this_means: The selected detector improved pooled held-out detection over the frozen baseline, but failed mandatory family-generalization and held-out seed-stability criteria.
limitations: Primary held-out result is FAIL despite 72.40% pooled detection.
Student-t df3 detection was 47.50%, below the registered 50% requirement.
Held-out seed spread was 18.75 percentage points, above the registered 10 pp limit.
This is controlled computational evidence, not physical certification.
